comment: PROPOSAL (REL-125), offline example. No model runs in the staging pass: a t3.small has 2 GiB, and the measured Whisper base RSS is 0.6-1.2 GB. These limits are for a later, larger host and are enforced by rehearsal/mock_model_smoke.py. Values in <> are filled from the owner-approved package.

probes.readyz: 200 only after every file matches the manifest, the model is loaded and one warm-up request succeeded; otherwise 503 with state starting/loading/failed

fallback: report unavailable once; no retry; no other model; the app keeps working without it
cleanup: keep the pinned package only while a next step is scheduled
record the deployment identity pair before and after
